## 1 – Installieren und einschalten

::: {.callout-warning}
## Interaktiv nur in HTML
Prüfen geht nur in der **HTML-Ausgabe** (`format: html`), also in Websites und Büchern. In PDF oder Word erscheint nur der Text der Aufgabe.
:::

Beide Aufgabentypen stecken im Paket **CTM Assessment**. Einmal je Projektordner, im Terminal:

```{.bash filename="Terminal"}
quarto add https://erasmus-ctm.github.io/ctm-assessment/ctm-assessment.zip     # Windows
quarto add https://erasmus-ctm.github.io/ctm-assessment/ctm-assessment.tar.gz  # macOS / Linux
```

Das Paket braucht Quarto **1.8.27 oder neuer** (`quarto --version`). **Einschalten** im YAML-Kopf der Seite:

```yaml
---
title: "Meine Aufgaben"
format: html
engine: markdown
filters:
  - ctm-assessment
---
```

`engine: markdown` ist ab Quarto 1.10 auf Seiten mit Aufgaben nötig. Enthält die Seite auch `{python}`-Blöcke, lass die Zeile weg.

{{< pagebreak >}}

## 2 – Aufgaben schreiben

**Python-Aufgabe** mit versteckten Tests. Oben steht, was Studierende sehen, unter `## TESTS ##` die Prüfung:

````markdown
```{py-exercise}
def quadrat(x):
    """Gib das Quadrat von x zurück."""
    pass

## TESTS ##
assert quadrat(3) == 9, "quadrat(3) sollte 9 sein"
```
````

**Mathe-Aufgabe**, geprüft mit SymPy. Die richtige Antwort steht in `_[...]`:

````markdown
```{math-exercise}
#| vars: r
Flächeninhalt eines Kreises mit r = 3: _[pi*9]
```
````

| Schreibweise | Bedeutung |
|---|---|
| `_[x]` / `__[x]` / `___[x]` | Feld schmal / mittel / breit |
| `vec[a,b]` / `mat[a,b;c,d]` | Vektor / Matrix, ein Feld je Eintrag |
| `vars: x, y` | Symbole, die in der Antwort vorkommen |
| `mode: numeric` | Zahlenwerte mit `tolerance:` vergleichen |

**Prüfen:** `quarto preview`. Beim ersten Klick lädt Python, das dauert einige Sekunden. Mach mit Absicht einen Fehler und lies die Rückmeldung.

{{< pagebreak >}}

## 3 – KI-Feedback und Speichern

| Was | Wie |
|---|---|
| Feedback-Knopf bei `py-exercise` | `py-exercise: feedback: true` im Seitenkopf, in jeder Aufgabe `task:` |
| Feedback-Knopf bei `math-exercise` | von selbst da, abschalten mit `math-exercise: feedback: false` |
| Standard | **Prompt kopieren**: fertiger Text für eine KI deiner Wahl, kein Konto nötig |
| Nicht mitgeschickt | Tests, erwartete Antworten, Prüfcode |
| Build ganz ohne KI | `CTM_FEEDBACK=off quarto render` |
| Antworten speichern | im Browser des Geräts, abschaltbar mit `ctm-assessment: save: none` |

---

Ausführlich: [Aufgabe mit automatischer Prüfung](https://erasmus-ctm.github.io/Quarto-Tutorial/de/int/Qmd%20Files/Getting%20Started/beg_check.html)

:::: {.content-visible when-profile="english"}

## 1 — Install & enable

::: {.callout-warning}
## Interactive in HTML only
Checking works only in **HTML output** (`format: html`), that is in websites and books. In PDF or Word only the text of the exercise appears.
:::

Both exercise types are in the package **CTM Assessment**. Once per project folder, in the Terminal:

```{.bash filename="Terminal"}
quarto add https://erasmus-ctm.github.io/ctm-assessment/ctm-assessment.zip     # Windows
quarto add https://erasmus-ctm.github.io/ctm-assessment/ctm-assessment.tar.gz  # macOS / Linux
```

The package needs Quarto **1.8.27 or newer** (`quarto --version`). **Enable it** in the page's YAML header:

```yaml
---
title: "My exercises"
format: html
engine: markdown
filters:
  - ctm-assessment
---
```

`engine: markdown` is needed from Quarto 1.10 on pages with exercises. If the page also has `{python}` blocks, leave the line out.

{{< pagebreak >}}

## 2 — Write exercises

**Python exercise** with hidden tests. Above is what students see, below `## TESTS ##` the check:

````markdown
```{py-exercise}
def square(x):
    """Return x squared."""
    pass

## TESTS ##
assert square(3) == 9, "square(3) should be 9"
```
````

**Maths exercise**, checked with SymPy. The correct answer is in `_[...]`:

````markdown
```{math-exercise}
#| vars: r
Area of a circle with r = 3: _[pi*9]
```
````

| Syntax | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `_[x]` / `__[x]` / `___[x]` | narrow / medium / wide field |
| `vec[a,b]` / `mat[a,b;c,d]` | vector / matrix, one field per entry |
| `vars: x, y` | symbols that appear in the answer |
| `mode: numeric` | compare numbers with `tolerance:` |

**Check:** `quarto preview`. On the first click Python loads, which takes a few seconds. Make a mistake on purpose and read the message.

{{< pagebreak >}}

## 3 — AI feedback & saving

| What | How |
|---|---|
| Feedback button for `py-exercise` | `py-exercise: feedback: true` in the page header, `task:` in every exercise |
| Feedback button for `math-exercise` | there by default, turn off with `math-exercise: feedback: false` |
| Default | **Copy prompt**: ready-made text for an AI of your choice, no account needed |
| Not sent | tests, expected answers, checker code |
| Build with no AI at all | `CTM_FEEDBACK=off quarto render` |
| Saving answers | in the device's browser, turn off with `ctm-assessment: save: none` |

---

In detail: [An exercise with automatic checking](https://erasmus-ctm.github.io/Quarto-Tutorial/en/int/Qmd%20Files/Getting%20Started/beg_check.html)

:::: {.content-visible when-profile="svenska"}

## 1 – Installera och slå på

::: {.callout-warning}
## Interaktivt bara i HTML
Kontrollen fungerar bara i **HTML-utdata** (`format: html`), alltså i webbplatser och böcker. I PDF eller Word visas bara uppgiftens text.
:::

Båda uppgiftstyperna finns i paketet **CTM Assessment**. En gång per projektmapp, i terminalen:

```{.bash filename="Terminal"}
quarto add https://erasmus-ctm.github.io/ctm-assessment/ctm-assessment.zip     # Windows
quarto add https://erasmus-ctm.github.io/ctm-assessment/ctm-assessment.tar.gz  # macOS / Linux
```

Paketet kräver Quarto **1.8.27 eller senare** (`quarto --version`). **Slå på det** i sidans YAML-huvud:

```yaml
---
title: "Mina uppgifter"
format: html
engine: markdown
filters:
  - ctm-assessment
---
```

`engine: markdown` behövs från Quarto 1.10 på sidor med uppgifter. Har sidan även `{python}`-block utelämnar du raden.

{{< pagebreak >}}

## 2 – Skriva uppgifter

**Python-uppgift** med dolda tester. Ovanför står det studenterna ser, under `## TESTS ##` kontrollen:

````markdown
```{py-exercise}
def kvadrat(x):
    """Returnera kvadraten av x."""
    pass

## TESTS ##
assert kvadrat(3) == 9, "kvadrat(3) ska vara 9"
```
````

**Matteuppgift**, kontrollerad med SymPy. Det rätta svaret står i `_[...]`:

````markdown
```{math-exercise}
#| vars: r
Area av en cirkel med r = 3: _[pi*9]
```
````

| Skrivsätt | Betydelse |
|---|---|
| `_[x]` / `__[x]` / `___[x]` | smalt / medelbrett / brett fält |
| `vec[a,b]` / `mat[a,b;c,d]` | vektor / matris, ett fält per post |
| `vars: x, y` | symboler som förekommer i svaret |
| `mode: numeric` | jämför tal med `tolerance:` |

**Kontrollera:** `quarto preview`. Vid första klicket laddas Python, vilket tar några sekunder. Gör ett fel med flit och läs meddelandet.

{{< pagebreak >}}

## 3 – AI-feedback och sparande

| Vad | Hur |
|---|---|
| Feedback-knapp för `py-exercise` | `py-exercise: feedback: true` i sidhuvudet, `task:` i varje uppgift |
| Feedback-knapp för `math-exercise` | finns som standard, stäng av med `math-exercise: feedback: false` |
| Standard | **Kopiera prompt**: färdig text för en AI efter eget val, inget konto behövs |
| Skickas inte | tester, förväntade svar, kontrollkod |
| Bygge helt utan AI | `CTM_FEEDBACK=off quarto render` |
| Spara svar | i enhetens webbläsare, kan stängas av med `ctm-assessment: save: none` |

---

Utförligt: [Uppgift med automatisk kontroll](https://erasmus-ctm.github.io/Quarto-Tutorial/sv/int/Qmd%20Files/Getting%20Started/beg_check.html)

:::: {.content-visible when-profile="norsk"}

## 1 – Installere og slå på

::: {.callout-warning}
## Interaktivt bare i HTML
Kontrollen fungerer bare i **HTML-utdata** (`format: html`), altså i nettsteder og bøker. I PDF eller Word vises bare teksten i oppgaven.
:::

Begge oppgavetypene ligger i pakken **CTM Assessment**. Én gang per prosjektmappe, i terminalen:

```{.bash filename="Terminal"}
quarto add https://erasmus-ctm.github.io/ctm-assessment/ctm-assessment.zip     # Windows
quarto add https://erasmus-ctm.github.io/ctm-assessment/ctm-assessment.tar.gz  # macOS / Linux
```

Pakken krever Quarto **1.8.27 eller nyere** (`quarto --version`). **Slå den på** i YAML-hodet på siden:

```yaml
---
title: "Oppgavene mine"
format: html
engine: markdown
filters:
  - ctm-assessment
---
```

`engine: markdown` trengs fra Quarto 1.10 på sider med oppgaver. Har siden også `{python}`-blokker, utelater du linjen.

{{< pagebreak >}}

## 2 – Skrive oppgaver

**Python-oppgave** med skjulte tester. Over står det studentene ser, under `## TESTS ##` kontrollen:

````markdown
```{py-exercise}
def kvadrat(x):
    """Returner kvadratet av x."""
    pass

## TESTS ##
assert kvadrat(3) == 9, "kvadrat(3) skal være 9"
```
````

**Matteoppgave**, kontrollert med SymPy. Det riktige svaret står i `_[...]`:

````markdown
```{math-exercise}
#| vars: r
Areal av en sirkel med r = 3: _[pi*9]
```
````

| Skrivemåte | Betydning |
|---|---|
| `_[x]` / `__[x]` / `___[x]` | smalt / middels / bredt felt |
| `vec[a,b]` / `mat[a,b;c,d]` | vektor / matrise, ett felt per oppføring |
| `vars: x, y` | symboler som forekommer i svaret |
| `mode: numeric` | sammenlign tall med `tolerance:` |

**Kontroller:** `quarto preview`. Ved første klikk lastes Python, og det tar noen sekunder. Gjør en feil med vilje og les meldingen.

{{< pagebreak >}}

## 3 – KI-tilbakemelding og lagring

| Hva | Hvordan |
|---|---|
| Tilbakemelding-knapp for `py-exercise` | `py-exercise: feedback: true` i sidehodet, `task:` i hver oppgave |
| Tilbakemelding-knapp for `math-exercise` | finnes som standard, slå av med `math-exercise: feedback: false` |
| Standard | **Kopier prompt**: ferdig tekst til en KI etter eget valg, ingen konto nødvendig |
| Sendes ikke | tester, forventede svar, kontrollkode |
| Bygging helt uten KI | `CTM_FEEDBACK=off quarto render` |
| Lagre svar | i nettleseren på enheten, kan slås av med `ctm-assessment: save: none` |

---

Utførlig: [Oppgave med automatisk kontroll](https://erasmus-ctm.github.io/Quarto-Tutorial/no/int/Qmd%20Files/Getting%20Started/beg_check.html)
